name: revflare
description: Self-hosted in-app purchase and subscription revenue tracker that runs entirely on Cloudflare (Workers, Durable Objects, R2, Workflows): App Store revenue straight from Apple, MRR, churn, cohorts, an iOS app, an MCP server and a CLI.
author: Ferdi

SECRET_KEY.description: Optional. A long random string used to encrypt stored App Store Connect keys and RevenueCat keys. If empty, a key is generated on first run and stored in the database.

SETUP_TOKEN.description: Optional. Required to create the first (admin) account, so nobody else can claim a fresh instance.

PUBLIC_URL.description: Optional. The public address of this instance (e.g. https://revflare.example.com). Defaults to the address of each request.
